user_query: trass gmail from last month with term avask

intent.goal: find gmail messages containing 'avask' from last month
intent._validation_feedback: No results found. Try broadening the search terms or date range.

generated_sql:
SELECT 
  u.page_id,
  u.title,
  u.created_time,
  g.sender_email,
  u.database_name
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE 
  (u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'trass.gmail'))
  AND (
    u.title LIKE '%avask%' 
    OR g.subject LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.sender_email LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.sender_name LIKE '%avask%'
    OR g.recipient_emails LIKE '%avask%'
  )
  AND u.created_time >= date('now', '-1 month')
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1000;
